name: Antipode, Fist of the Horizon

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus : +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Antipodal
effects.tooltip: Antipodal : This weapon is a carefully balanced confluence of diametrically opposed planar energies. This weapon deals an extra 1d6 points of Good damage to non-Good enemies, an extra 1d6 points of Evil damage to non-Evil enemies, an extra 1d6 points of Law damage to non-Lawful enemies, and an extra 1d6 points of Chaotic damage to non-Chaotic enemies.

effects.name: Doublestrike
effects.tooltip: Doublestrike 6% : Passive: 6% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)

effects.name: Reinforced Fists
effects.tooltip: Reinforced Fists : This item surrounds your fists with kinetic energy. Your unarmed damage is boosted by one half die.

effects.name: Stunning
effects.tooltip: Stunning +10 : +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.

customisation_hints.name: Attuned to Heroism
children: Attuned by Heroism: Tier 1 Adds Planar Conflux
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 2 +7 Enhancement Bonus → +8 Enhancement Bonus
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 3 Adds +0.5 weapon dice multiplier
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 4 Adds Red Augment Slot

flavor_text: Spun from enchanted golden thread, this cloth was created to harness and contain planer energies. When wrapped around ones hands, their unarmed attacks can unleash those energies to devastating effect.
tips: This weapon is the best way to determine a monster's alignment . For instance, if the target takes Chaotic and Good damage, it must be Lawful Evil; but if it takes Evil, Good, and Lawful damage, it's Chaotic Neutral.

source.raw: Caught in the Web , End Chest
